notes_for_editor: Generic name; the OSM node gives no builder, date or height. TopoQuest's Christman Fire Tower (historical) is at N40.916478 W75.681301, about 12 km southwest of this node, so it is probably a different site (not verified). The cached FFLOS register page for christmans-tower-site (firetower.org) says a steel Aermotor tower was built in 1921, moved in 1925 and renamed Mauch Chunk, with no coordinates; not used in the story. Do not confuse with NHLR's Mauch Chunk tower (US 1265, Weiser State Forest, 1936, 40.873685 -75.699445), which is a different structure. Status 'standing' is unverified. Two searches found nothing about this node.
